audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read [Akali, Akali, Skill, Skill, Akali, Skill, Skill] while content win[] and the packet both read [Viktor x4, Skill, Akali, Viktor]. Nineteen fields also misgender Akali as he/him.
audit.why: Akali has no dash until 6 and pays energy for everything; Viktor's 525-range E pokes her step-ups freely pre-6. Level 6 evens it, first item flips it to her, two items flips it back. Content whys already argue exactly this.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved to match win[], with whys and ratings rewritten to agree; win[] untouched per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' fabricated in spikes[0].text and early; kit names Viktor's E Hextech Ray.
audit.corrected: Renamed in both places. Spike set (pre-6 poke window / R flip at 6 / Rocketbelt-Riftmaker spike / two-item takeover) is sound.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad; Shuriken Flip's minion-block and Perfect Execution's execute threshold were unstated in the bullets.
audit.why: Shroud is 20s at rank 1, her R 120s at rank 1; Viktor W 17s, R 120s. Shuriken Flip is a projectile that marks the first enemy hit, so the minion line denies her dash access. Her R recast executes — being at half HP is the danger zone.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with numbers; bleed bullets replaced with minion-line vs Shuriken Flip and execute-range warnings.

audit.why: It is her only defensive tool pre-6; the shove window while it is down is concrete.
